why: The price of keeping the abbreviation list narrow, and the reason company suffixes are deliberately NOT in it: 'Acme Inc.', 'Acme Corp.' and 'Main St.' commonly DO end a sentence in this domain. Listing them closes gate-residual-company-suffix-before-a-capitalised-name and breaks all three of these — that is the trade, and this case is what prices it.

rows.content: We are dealing with Acme Inc. The cap is Green.
Payment goes to Acme Corp. The cap is Green.
Deliver to the office on Main St. The cap is Green.
